Joel Huiqui should stick with the 5-3-2 shape that has served him in four of the last five matches. Gudiño keeps his spot in goal on appearances, while the back five of Ditta, Piovi, Campos, Orozco and Mozo have logged the most minutes among the defensive group. Fernández and Ibañez combine for three goals and two assists over the last five games and remain the clearest attacking threats.

### Juarez possible starting eleven

Monchu and Rodríguez supply creativity behind Estupiñan, who stays the lone focal point up front and the player most likely to trouble Cruz Azul’s defense on the counter.
